description: AUSTIN– Representative Trey Wharton joined the Texas Water Caucus, a nonpartisan educational platform supporting the next generation of water champions and ensuring water is prioritized, as a Vice Chair. title: RELEASE: Rep. Trey Wharton Joins Texas Bicameral Water Caucus - Trey Wharton For Texas State Representative District 12
